metadata.question: Does the surface water extent in Sindh province, Pakistan increase in September 21, 2020 compared to September 21, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: JRC Global Surface Water (good for water extent analysis) - Date: September 21, 2019 vs September 21, 2020 - Location: Sindh province, Pakistan - Need to define geometry for Sindh province 2. Masking strategy: - JRC data is already processed, no cloud masking needed - Use the "occurrence" band which shows frequency of water detection 3. Logic: - Calculate total water pixels for each date - Compare 2020 vs 2019 - If 2020 > 2019: A (Yes) - If 2020 <= 2019: B (No) - Handle cases where no data or no valid pixels The JRC Global Surface Water dataset provides monthly water occurrence data. I'll use the "occurrence" band which shows the frequency of water detection (0-100). I'll consider pixels with occurrence > 0 as water for this comparison. For geometry, I'll create a rough polygon for Sindh province, Pakistan. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Rough polygon for Sindh province, Pakistan var sindh = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[66.0, 23.5], [72.0, 23.5], [72.0, 28.5], [66.0, 28.5], [66.0, 23.5]] ]); var date2019 = '2019-09-21'; var date2020 = '2020-09-21'; // 2. Data Acquisition - JRC Global Surface Water Monthly History var jrc2019 = ee.ImageCollection('JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory') .filterDate(date2019, '2019-09-22') .filterBounds(sindh); var jrc2020 = ee.ImageCollection('JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory') .filterDate(date2020, '2020-09-22') .filterBounds(sindh); // Check collection sizes var size2019 = jrc2019.size().getInfo(); var size2020 = jrc2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images: ${size2019}, 2020 Images: ${size2020}`); if (size2019 === 0 || size2020 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get the images var img2019 = jrc2019.first(); var img2020 = jrc2020.first(); // 3. Processing - Count water pixels (monthly classification: 2=water, 3=permanent water) var water2019 = img2019.eq(2).or(img2019.eq(3)); var water2020 = img2020.eq(2).or(img2020.eq(3)); // Count water pixels var count2019 = water2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: sindh, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('water').getInfo(); var count2020 = water2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: sindh, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('water').getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Water Pixels: ${count2019}, 2020 Water Pixels: ${count2020}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (count2019 === null || count2020 === null || count2019 === 0 || count2020 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation & Validation if (count2019 === null || count2020 === null || isNaN(count2019) || isNaN(count2020)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // 5. Final Answer var percentChange = ((count2020 - count2019) / count2019 * 100).toFixed(1); console.log(`Change: ${percentChange}%`); if (count2020 > count2019) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
